capabilities: Render a Markdown CV live in a side pane
Check page fit and mark page breaks
Export the CV as a PDF through headless Chrome
Report keyword coverage against a pasted job posting
Lint the CV format and jump to flagged lines
extras: Desktop only. PDF export needs a locally installed Chrome, Chromium, Edge, or Brave; the plugin makes no network requests and sends no telemetry. The preview's page estimate does not check where the page split falls, so the PDF must be checked.
problem: Obsidian shows Markdown notes but gives no page layout view or PDF output for a CV, so fitting one to printed pages is guesswork.

relations.evidence: Export launches a locally installed Chrome, Chromium, Edge, or Brave through child_process to print the PDF.
The folder picker and save dialog use Electron dialogs.

summary: Renders a Markdown CV in a side pane with page-fit checks, keyword coverage against a job posting, and PDF export through headless Chrome.
